newsitem.title: ITALY: Stet to invest 40 trln lire in 1997-99.
newsitem.headline: Stet to invest 40 trln lire in 1997-99.

text.p: Italian telecommunications holding company Stet plans to invest 40 trillion lire in 1997-99 to boost its core business, chairman Biagio Agnes told an extraordinary shareholders' meeting on Monday.
He did not immediately go into details.

The meeting has been called to discuss the spin-off of Yellow Pages publisher Seat. The Italian government has demanded that Seat be sold off before Stet's privatisation, which is due by March 31, next year.

"This operation (the Seat spin-off) launches the first phase of the group's privatisation," Agnes said. "Stet intends to gain an ever more dynamic and rooted presence abroad and the recent accord with Bouygues for the French market confirms this," he said.
Stet reached a deal with the French conglomerate earlier this month to set up a new telecoms joint-venture seeking to rival France Telecom after liberalisation of the sector in 1998.
